text.p: Air Littoral has signed a firm order for seven Canadair Regional Jet aircraft and optioned an additional five from Bombardier Inc's Regional Aircraft Division, Bombardier and Air Littoral said Thursday.
Bombardier said the value of the seven firm aircraft is more than US$133 million (C$178 million). It said it will complete deliveries by the fourth quarter of 1997.
Air Littoral plans to use the new aircraft on routes from elsewhere in France to its new hub in Nice and to additional destinations in Spain and Italy, the companies said.
Currently, Air Littoral operates seven Canadair Jet aircraft for Groupe Air France on domestic and European routes.
